name: @kratai-desci/llm
description: LLM client and prompt/response handling shared across kratai apps - the seam between kratai's own deterministic static analysis and anything that needs a model call (use case diagram extraction, AI chat). Published so kratai-web (a separate repo, not part of this npm workspace) can depend on the exact same extraction/validation logic the desktop app uses, so the two never drift on what counts as a correct use case diagram.
